input.description: Locally authored Codex guide with source-traced glyph, corrected shell normals, seated glyph relief, portable skin roots, and twelve retained animation clips. Internal production asset; no independent redistribution license is asserted for the source logo.

provenance.prompt: Use the supplied Codex logo as the personified guide to a high-quality educational tour through the Codex ecosystem.
provenance.negativePrompt: Do not invent another logo or distort the original glyph; no paid provider generation.
provenance.notes: Source raster is game/public/assets/codex-reference.png, hash retained in art-source/glyph-contours.json. Source authoring and all actions are preserved in art-source/codex-mascot-traced-glyph-v4.blend. Export is normalized only by promoting identity-transform skinned nodes; full binary payload is preserved at that normalization stage. Material design uses vertex color and PBR constants, so image textures/UVs are not required by this asset policy. Package integrity is separate from source-logo rights and final release approval.
